mapper.insert: insert into user_bill (user_id, category_id, amount, type, create_time, remark) values (#{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{createTime}, #{remark})
mapper.select: select user_bill.*,category.name as categoryName from user_bill left join category on user_bill.category_id = category.id where user_bill.user_id = #{userId} and user_bill.id = #{billId}
